{1: 'Constellia'}
{2: 'Constellia.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory545.jpg', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: "According to the latest intel from our intelligence division, what we're looking for is in Constellia.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Celica', 3: 'The bad news is that the tracker is being disrupted. Constellia has too many similar signals in circulation, and the intercepted fragments share too many overlapping traits with them.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'The Science Council is already analyzing it, but it will take some time.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's alright, as long as we can make sure there's no risk of it leaving the city.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'WGAA has designated a commandant they trust to act as your liaison for this operation.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "I'm sure you're no stranger to that commandant.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: '【kuroname】?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hello, Celica.', 3: '21', 4: 'Hello, Adelyde.', 5: '21'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "【kuroname】, it's you.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "You're just as good a fit from where I stand. Saves us the trouble of learning how to work with each other.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'I look forward to seeing you two work together.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'According to our last report, the mechanoid carrying the target has no idea of its actual worth, and has been looking for an opportunity to offload it.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Constellia's commercial district is hosting a large market fair right now, so the target is likely planning to sell the item there.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Of course, we'll support you as soon as we can. In the meantime, we'll need you to proceed with the investigation until we have something concrete.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Move quickly, but don't tip anyone off.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Understood.', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory667.jpg', 2: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory965.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'With the mission details confirmed, Celica ends the call without another word.'}
{3: 'Only the two of you remain on the comms channel.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Let's figure out our next move.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'What do you think, Commandant?', 4: '11'}
{2: "Let's start at the market.", 3: '46'}
{2: 'We can blend in as customers.', 3: '47', 4: 'We can pose as a vendor.', 5: '51'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Blending in as customers... A solid call.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Let's do it.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Posing as a vendor... and waiting for the target to come to us. It's lower profile, and it's a solid move.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'That said, setting up a stall takes a lot of time, making it less viable.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory669.jpg'}
{3: 'The Constellia market is bustling with activity. Stalls line the streets, displaying goods of all kinds.'}

{3: "Vendors' calls, the clang of metal, and confusing post-modern music rise and fall in the commercial district. Also mixed into the air is the smell of food, machine oil, and the distinct mustiness of thrifted goods."}
{1: '1', 3: 'Adelyde stands at the market entrance, surveying the scene before her like an unmarked battlefield expressionlessly.'}
{2: 'Not used to visiting places like this?', 3: '68'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...Clearing them out is more my speed.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "No matter. I'll just think of it as a supply run.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'There are still some differences between them...', 3: '73'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "In that case, I'll follow your lead.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Let's assess the situation first and figure out a plan of action.", 3: '75'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Certainly. The real shape of the target object is unknown, since the target mechanoid has it concealed inside a specially sealed box.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "According to Babylonia's intel, the target mechanoid is looking to offload the item. So our focus should be on stalls that deal in reclaimed goods.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "On top of that, our data shows that Constellia's market is quite the affair. Anything of value can be bought or sold here.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'There may also be an intel market here somewhere, which could also give us a lead.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Any thoughts, Commandant?', 4: '1'}
{2: "Intel is only good when it's fresh.", 3: '84'}
{2: 'If there are intel brokers around, that should be our first stop.', 3: '85'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Exactly. "Occasio praeceps."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'That said, are intel brokers really that easy to come by...?', 3: '87'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's one right over there.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: '终端共享了阿德莱德那边捕捉到的画面信息。在画面中，一个头部涂装为暗红色的机械体正在大声吆喝着。'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'News of the world, big and small, all at your doorstep! Fresh off the press this morning! Who wants a copy!?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: '"But I don\'t care about the world! I only care about myself!" Well, whatever you\'re interested in, I\'ve got it! Fresh intel, guaranteed!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Fair prices and no tricks! If the news is old, it's free!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 5: '11'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab'}
{2: 'So intel is sold by freshness, just like produce?', 3: '104'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's some truth to that. Intel loses its value over time.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Knowing the value of his goods means he knows the trade, at the very least.', 4: '1'}
{2: '(Then again, that might just be his sales pitch...)', 3: '107'}
{3: 'Adelyde approaches the vendor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "What are you interested in, ma'am? I've got all kinds of papers right here!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Or perhaps... you're here for the card game tournament? Looking to take home the prize?", 4: '2'}
{2: '(Something about that tournament sounds awfully suspicious...)', 3: '114'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Intel.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Has a mechanoid carrying a box come through here looking to sell?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'The way you carry yourself, I half expected you to be a card shark!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'A box? Something like this?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The vendor holds his hands apart to indicate the size of the box, then mimes putting on a hat.'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "The mechanoid's wearing a hood, too, yeah?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "You've come to the right person. I happen to know something about this mechanoid.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "But, well... intel doesn't come cheap like a newspaper does...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Just spit it out.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'Would 500 Black Cards work for you...?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'You just bought it.', 3: '128'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "It's the most efficient way.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'A woman of few words! I like that!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "The one you're looking for headed that way not long ago.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The vendor gestures toward somewhere nearby, where a nondescript alley hides in the shadows between two buildings.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory669.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory669.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'Oh, and feel free to enter that card game tournament I just mentioned! Plenty of great prizes for the winners!', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'The two of you immediately head that way.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory672.jpg'}
{3: 'Ten minutes later, at the end of the alley.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I've checked. There are no side paths, nowhere to hide, and nothing to climb over.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's just a graffiti-covered wall.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Our target would've been gone by now.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The vendor said "not long ago."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'He never specified exactly how long ago that was.', 4: '1'}
{2: "...I suppose that's not exactly a lie.", 3: '162'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The only lead left is the cafe still open in the alley.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Odd place to run a cafe.', 3: '166'}
{2: 'Shall we go in and ask?', 3: '167'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Our operation needs to stay under wraps from the general public.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'But the case comes first.', 3: '169', 4: 'We can go in disguise.', 5: '169'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...Alright.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory748.jpg'}
{3: 'The door swings open, and the chime above rings out. A mechanoid largely coated in red is polishing a coffee cup behind the counter before spotting you and setting down the cup to greet you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: 'Welcome!', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "Please, have a seat! What can I get for you? Whatever flavor of electrolyte you're interested in, I've got it!", 4: '3'}
{2: '(That attitude feels awfully familiar...)', 3: '182', 4: "(These words... We've heard them before...)", 5: '182'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "What's your connection to that intel broker from before?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "I-intel broker? We're just a small cafe trying to get by...", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'A poor excuse for a lie.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The way you both speak and dress... People who live together long enough tend to rub off on each other.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "Sharp eye, ma'am...", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "The one you're referring to would be my brother.", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So you two are working together to lure people here and spend money at your shop?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'He was selling fake intel?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Adelyde's voice is ice-cold."}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "I'm innocent! I don't know what you're talking about!", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "How about this... let me brew you something with the beans we just got in. It's a fresh delivery, and they're really something special...", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's not necessary. I'm in a hurry.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Commandant, this lead has gone cold. We're back to square one.", 4: '1'}
{2: "I suppose there's nothing we can do.", 3: '201'}
{3: 'The door chime rings again. A familiar mechanoid steps inside.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Bro, money's coming in fast today! Guess what just happened... A lady asked me for directions, and I pointed her this way before I realized it leads to—", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Oh whoa! What a coincidence! You actually came to the shop, ma'am!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: 'So, did you find the person you were looking for?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "What do you mean? You didn't point us in the wrong direction?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "As if I'd ever do something like that! I got paid to do a job, and reputation is everything in this line of work!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "You're looking for someone in a cloak, carrying a box about this big, no?", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The vendor does the exact same gestures as before, beating his chest with total confidence.'}
{2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Came straight here! I'd stake my reputation on it!", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: 'Someone in a cloak...?', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: 'Someone like that did come by just a little while ago.', 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's the person I'm looking for. Did this person do or say anything after coming here?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The cafe owner scratches his head and heads to the back.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: 'Give me a second.', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Lucky us, I guess?', 3: '232'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I don't follow. What was that mechanoid doing in a cafe?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Maybe our target was thirsty and wanted a drink?', 3: '235', 4: 'Maybe our target just wanted to unwind?', 5: '235', 6: 'Maybe the owner is part of the problem.', 7: '237'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "...That's one possibility.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "We can't rule out the owner. Something fishy might be going on in there.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'Adelyde? Commandant?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: "Good news. The Science Council's results are in, and the signal source has been stationary for over an hour.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Not only did they re-lock onto the source, they also analyzed its electromagnetic traits and cross-referenced them against material models in the database to narrow down what the target object might be.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'The report just came in—wait, uh...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Huh?', 3: '256', 4: 'I have a bad feeling about this...', 5: '256'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Uh... The object was initially suspected to be a rare biological material, one that plays a significant role in ongoing research on stabilizing M.I.N.D.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'However, after careful analysis, the Science Council has determined that it more closely resembles a plant from the Rubiaceae family in the same region...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Which means it could be... a box of coffee beans...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "Hey, ma'am! I got it!", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "The one you're looking for came by and sold me something. Here, take a look!", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: 'These coffee beans are incredibly rare. The yield is minuscule, and everyone says a cup of this feels like a spa day for your mind!', 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mechanoid Vendor A', 3: "Oh, now that's a rare find. They even use it as a special prize at the card game tournament.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "That's what I'd expect from you, bro. You know quality when you see it.", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "Ma'am, these are actually the beans I was going to treat you to! And I've already ground some, as luck would have it. So, what do you say?", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "Huh? Why do you look so pale, ma'am?", 4: '3'}
{2: "...We've been tracking coffee beans?", 3: '272'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Celica, given the change in mission objective, should we reassess the mission level?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'But... ugh... regardless, we still need to collect a sample before calling it a day...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Besides, the Science Council did mention that byproducts sharing the same environmental factors could still be useful for research...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Can we just hand in the coffee?', 3: '283'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Probably... not... The proteins, cellular structure, and DNA in the beans' embryos are all completely destroyed in the coffee...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "So we'll have to obtain a plant sample.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Didn't the broker mention something about a tournament prize?", 3: '289'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cafe Owner', 3: "You're not talking to me, are you? Would you still like some coffee? Ma'am? Hello?", 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: '...The card game tournament your friend just mentioned... What was that about?', 4: '1'}
